title: NJ PBS announces Rob Nelson as anchor of new daily newscast
summary: Veteran journalist and New Jersey native will lead NJ PBS News with Rob Nelson, launching as part of the station's new era under Montclair State University

heroImage.alt: A portrait of journalist Rob Nelson smiling and wearing a suit.

title: NJ PBS announces six staff appointments
summary: New leaders and producers bring experience across public media, journalism, audience development, programming, digital storytelling and broadcast operations

heroImage.alt: Six newly appointed NJ PBS staff members pictured in individual headshots arranged in a two-by-three grid against a blue geometric background. The appointments support the newsroom, programming, audience development, digital content and media operations.
